# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| IterativeTDDRunner | src.agents.iterative_tdd_runner | Orchestrates the RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop across multiple cycles |
| TDDCycleRunner | src.agents.tdd_cycle_runner | Runs one complete TDD cycle with GREEN retries and learning |
| IncrementalPlanner | src.agents.incremental_planner | Determines the next test increment using LLM |
| PythonLanguagePod | src.agents.python_language_pod | LanguagePod implementation for Python TDD cycles |
| WorkerAgent | src.agents.worker_agent | Generates code for each TDD phase via LLM |
| PodmanOrchestrator | src.agents.podman_orchestrator | Stateless sidecar execution layer for containerised test runs |
| PodmanRunner | src.agents.podman_runner | Production ContainerRunner backed by rootless Podman |
| PlaybookManager | src.playbook.manager | Manages playbook CRUD, delta updates, and persistence |
| ExperimentLogger | src.storage.experiment_logger | Logs TDD cycles and ML experiments to database |
| LLMClient | src.utils.llm_client | Unified LLM client supporting multiple providers |
| Reflector | src.core.reflector.module | Analyzes task outcomes and extracts learning insights |
| Curator | src.core.curator.module | Synthesizes insights into playbook delta bullets |
| Generator | src.core.generator.module | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM generation |
| BulletRetriever | src.playbook.retrieval | Hybrid retrieval engine for selecting relevant bullets |
| ContextMapBuilder | src.utils.context_map | Builds AST context maps from source files |
| ImportFilter | src.agents.import_filter | Checks generated code for forbidden imports |
| GherkinFeatureBridge | src.agents.gherkin_feature_bridge | Parses Gherkin .feature files into FeatureSpec |
| PolyglotTDDRunner | src.agents.polyglot_tdd_runner | Drives TDD across multiple LanguagePods |
| AutonomousTDDAgent | src.agents.autonomous_tdd_agent | Builds features autonomously using TDD with ensemble learning |
| TestReviewAgent | src.agents.test_review_agent | Validates test quality before implementation |
| RedundancyPreChecker | src.agents.redundancy_checker | Pre-checks proposed tests for redundancy |
| TDDFailureRecorder | src.agents.tdd_failure_recorder | Records TDD failures and interventions for self-improvement |
| TDDLessonInjector | src.agents.tdd_lesson_injector | Injects TDD lessons into agent prompts |
| EnsembleLearner | src.ensemble.learner | Orchestrates multiple models learning in parallel |
| PerformanceAggregator | src.broker.performance_aggregator | Extracts metrics from audit trail for agent performance |
| AdaptiveBroker | src.broker.adaptive_broker | Routes tasks to best agent based on historical performance |
| CapabilityRegistry | src.broker.capability_registry | Tracks anonymous agent capabilities |
| AuditStore | src.audit.store | Append-only audit event store with hash chain integrity |
| AuditClient | src.audit.client | Write-only audit client for ACE agents |
| InstitutionalKnowledgeService | src.retrieval.service | Central knowledge retrieval service for code generation |
| DistillationRouter | src.playbook.distillation_router | Routes tasks to domain-specific distillation playbooks |
| PlaybookRepository | src.storage.repository | PostgreSQL repository with pgvector for semantic search |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Cycle as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant Orchestrator as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Playbook as PlaybookManager
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger

    Runner->>Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle)
    Planner-->>Runner: TestIncrement

    loop for each cycle (max iterations)
        Runner->>Cycle: run(PodSpec)
        activate Cycle

        Cycle->>Pod: run_red(spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
        Worker-->>Pod: test_code
        Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse({test_file: code})
        Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        Pod-->>Cycle: red_result
        deactivate Pod

        alt RED aborted (security/policy failure)
            Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult(success=false)
        else RED passed
            loop GREEN attempts (max_green_attempts)
                Cycle->>Pod: run_green(spec)
                activate Pod
                Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec, error_feedback)
                Worker-->>Pod: impl_code
                Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse({test, impl})
                Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                Pod-->>Cycle: green_result
                deactivate Pod
                alt GREEN passed
                    break
                else GREEN failed
                    Note right of Cycle: error_feedback updated
                end
            end

            alt GREEN failed after all attempts
                Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult(success=false)
            else GREEN passed
                Cycle->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
                activate Pod
                Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse({test, impl})
                Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                Pod-->>Cycle: refactor_result
                deactivate Pod

                opt Learning loop (if reflector & curator configured)
                    Cycle->>Cycle: _learn(spec, result)
                    Note right of Cycle: Reflector -> Curator -> PlaybookManager.apply_delta
                end

                Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult(success=true)
            end
        end

        deactivate Cycle

        Runner->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
        alt Planner says COMPLETE
            break
        end
    end

    Runner-->>Runner: return IterativeResult
```
